Calling `buildNotSupportedComment('showsnippet')` returns '{# !showsnippet is not supported in HubL! #}'
Calling `buildNotSupportedComment('break')` returns '{# !break is not supported in HubL! #}'
`composer analyze` reports zero errors after this change

summary: Added `protected static function buildNotSupportedComment(string $commandId): string` to `tests/assets/classes/HubLTestCase.php`. The method returns `sprintf('{# !%s is not supported in HubL! #}', strtolower($commandId))`, matching the canonical format in `BaseSyntax::translateCommand()`. Includes full PHPDoc with @param and @return. PHPStan level 9 passes with zero errors.

comments.note: No observations — code in HubLTestCase.php is clean and consistent. The new method follows the existing style perfectly.

comments.note: The `@see BaseSyntax::translateCommand()` docblock tag uses the short class name rather than the FQCN `Mailcode\Translator\BaseSyntax`. In the test namespace (`MailcodeTestClasses`), IDEs cannot resolve the reference without an import or FQCN. Non-blocking cosmetic; consider using `@see \Mailcode\Translator\BaseSyntax::translateCommand()` in a future pass.

The helper hardcodes the word 'HubL' in the format string, which makes it HubL-specific and prevents lifting to a generic test base. This is intentional and correct for `HubLTestCase`, but worth noting if similar helpers are needed for other syntaxes in the future.
